dataset.name: Swiss Dwellings
dataset.attribution: Standfest, M., Franzen, M., Schröder, Y., Gonzalez Medina, L., Villanueva Hernandez, Y., Buck, J. H., Tan, Y.-L., Niedzwiecka, M., Colmegna, R. (2023). Swiss Dwellings: A large dataset of apartment models. Archilyse AG. Zenodo.
dataset.changes: A subset of two- and three-storey homes (maisonettes). Rooms, walls, doors, windows and staircases only (features other than stairs, balconies and simulation results dropped). All storeys rotated together so walls run along the axes, translated to the origin, rounded to 1 cm.
